title: The transform generation this contract's evidence belongs to
why: A fixture or a store record is evidence about the transform that produced it, and only about that one. The frozen collection was once found to hold 67 materials whose tangent numbers predated a correction and were evidence of nothing -- they looked exactly like current ones. So the current fingerprint is recorded in ONE place that both repositories read, rather than as a constant hard-coded on each side where the two can drift silently.
evidence_status: This fingerprint identifies current code as of 2026-10-08 (corpus robustness campaign, batch B20: the discovery-cache write guard, the callee and include lookups, the growth instrument and the transformer fixes freed by Gauss move the fingerprint). The current corpus evidence is pass25 (2026-10-08, harness cfd84cd2fe97e72b, contract 5.0.0, commit a7b6b4b): all 419 acquired sources re-transformed (311 transform, 285 compile) and every stored entry re-verified in Abaqus 2021 -- 115 verified in Abaqus under the D-4 tangent gate of 242 as published (106 at pass24; the 106 of pass24 are all still verified, 9 entered), 115 of 247 with the revised callee rule (242 minus 5 plus 10), 118 of 242 at the routine level (114 at pass24) and 0 of the 14 new sources -- and the 122 cases frozen at pass25 fingerprints; 5 growth rows are reported apart as inferred from state targets and counted nowhere. The discovery cache hashed identically before and after the pass. The two Residual Assembler fixtures in tests/fixtures/verified were regenerated at this fingerprint. Corpus pass24 (50ae446f12de66d8 / 0b2c472c7085b594; 106 of 242 and 114 of 242) and every earlier pass are history. The verified collection under umat/ (pass12, 94a92c01814f107a), the ten fixtures under Residual Assembler tests/fixtures/historical and every earlier generation stay retired from current capability claims and regression baselines: preserve their original generation and numerical observations and read them only as history. The re-freeze procedure is documented in docs/evidence/final_refreeze.md in both repositories.
covers: every file under src/umat_oti whose suffix is .py, .f90, .f, .for or .inc, except the subpackages listed in umat_oti.store.transform_store.NOT_TRANSFORM_CODE, which cannot change a stored transform
how_to_update: Run umat_oti.store.transform_fingerprint(), put the result here, regenerate contract_lock.json, and copy both into Residual_Assembler/schemas/. Everything frozen at the previous value is now evidence about a transform that no longer exists: re-freeze it or read it only as history. This is NOT a contract version bump -- the shape of the agreement is unchanged; what changed is which evidence is current.
consumers_must: refuse a fixture whose transform_fingerprint differs from this value as a regression baseline, and treat a fixture carrying no fingerprint as NOT ESTABLISHED rather than as current
